definitions.explanation: A thin layer of ice crystals that forms on surfaces when the temperature drops below freezing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フロントガラス→フロントガラス：25689_furontogarasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{霜|しも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つい→付く：01960_tsuku⟧て⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There was frost on the car's windshield.

examples.japanese: {霜|しも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{甘|あま}み→甘味：07017_amami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧。⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{白菜|はくさい}→白菜：13606_hakusai⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{霜|しも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美味|おい}しく→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When the frost season comes, vegetables become sweeter. Chinese cabbage and spinach in particular become more delicious when exposed to frost.

notes:
{霜|しも} refers to frost - ice crystals that form on cold surfaces.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {霜|しも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ (frost forms/falls)
- {霜|しも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (frost forms on something)
- {霜|しも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to be exposed to frost)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{初霜|はつしも}→初霜：18804_hatsushimo⟧ (first frost of the season)
- ⟦{霜柱|しもばしら}→霜柱：08560_shimobashira⟧ (frost columns/needles in soil)
- ⟦{霜焼|しもや}け→しもやけ：24993_shimoyake⟧ (frostbite, chilblains)
- {霜|しも}⟦{除|よ}け→除け：noentry⟧ (frost protection)

SEASONAL NOTE:
{霜|しも} is associated with late autumn and winter. ⟦{霜月|しもつき}→霜月：noentry⟧ is an old name for November.
